tasks.title: Design the workflow file format
instructions: Propose a JSON layout for tasks, connections, and canvas positions.
Keep multi-line text readable in a plain text editor.
Store no view state other than node positions.
acceptanceCriteria: A three-task sample opens in a text editor without escaped line breaks.
Chinese text such as 审查说明 stays readable.

tasks.title: Implement atomic save
instructions: Write the file to a temporary sibling, flush it to disk, then rename it over the target.
acceptanceCriteria: Killing the process during save leaves the previous file intact.

tasks.title: Review the storage change
acceptanceCriteria: The reviewer approves the diff or lists the required changes.
